test_Llama3Tokenizer_special_tokens: test the Llama3Tokenizer special tokens dictionary to verify begin_of_text maps to 128000
test_Llama3Tokenizer_encode: test the Llama3Tokenizer encode method to convert text into a list of token IDs
test_Llama3Tokenizer_decode: test the Llama3Tokenizer decode method to convert a list of token IDs back into text
test_ChatFormat_encode_message: test the ChatFormat encode_message method to convert a role and content dict into token IDs
test_ChatFormat_encode_dialog_prompt: test the ChatFormat encode_dialog_prompt method to encode a multi-turn dialog into token IDs
